referential_and_visual.triangulation_limitation: Qwen2-VL and Qwen3-VL are different architecture generations and checkpoints but share vendor lineage, so their disagreement envelope is less independent than the planned Qwen-versus-Gemma pair.

optional.gemma4_e4b_it_4bit: inactive because the exact conversion failed the license-provenance gate before download or restricted inference; reconsider only in a separately frozen protocol after unambiguous permission evidence
optional.qwen3_6: excluded because it adds size without a distinct required annotation role

frozen_comparisons.speech_boundary: Maximum-cardinality bipartite one-to-one interval matching at a 500 ms onset-and-offset collar. Among maximum-cardinality matchings minimize total absolute onset-plus-offset error, then break remaining ties by canonical interval index. Report precision, recall, and F1 as model-model agreement.
frozen_comparisons.transcript: Pair matched non-abstained German-source regions. Normalize with Unicode NFKC, Unicode casefold, punctuation-to-space, and whitespace collapse while preserving German letters before casefold. Report the mean of both directional WERs and both directional CERs as disagreement only; never translate or name either path as reference.
frozen_comparisons.referential_fields: raw agreement, Cohen kappa when mathematically defined, per-model prevalence, abstention, and schema validity

uncertainty.model_specific: For each instrument path, report a 95% item-cluster bootstrap interval with 5000 fixed-seed resamples.
uncertainty.intersection: Windows where both task-family instruments emit the same non-abstain bin; report its prevalence interval without treating it as truth.
uncertainty.union: Windows where either task-family instrument emits the bin; report its prevalence interval without treating it as truth.
uncertainty.envelope: For each calibration dimension, take the minimum lower and maximum upper bound across model-specific, intersection, and union estimates, then round outward to the simulator grid resolution.
uncertainty.disagreement: Retain as its own rate and widen the envelope; never resolve it by voting.

grid_rounding.rate_dimensions: round lower bounds down and upper bounds up to the nearest 0.10
grid_rounding.absolute_lag_event_units: map categorical lag bins to closed event-unit bands and round outward to the nearest 0.5 event duration
grid_rounding.candidate_multiplicity: preserve the ordinal zero/one/two/three-or-more bins; simulator uses 0, 1, 2, and 4 candidates respectively
grid_rounding.visibility: preserve categorical visibility and round partial-or-clear prevalence outward to 0.10
grid_rounding.support: round noun-object and verb-action support prevalence outward to 0.10
grid_rounding.clamp: all rates to [0,1]; lag magnitude to [0,2.5] event durations

predeclared_gates.calibration_usable: Both task families meet path count, schema, coverage, and abstention gates; every requested simulator dimension has a model-specific interval and a conservative envelope.
predeclared_gates.calibration_revise: A required path fails licensing, public canary, network denial, schema, coverage, or quarantine confinement after one bounded engineering retry, or an envelope cannot be formed.
predeclared_gates.calibration_stop: Restricted processing cannot remain local/private or no distinct model pair can emit the required dimensions.

simulator_binding.later_reporting: Report the causal conclusion separately for each instrument-specific range, the intersection range, the union range, and their conservative envelope.

privacy_and_execution.referential_crosswalk: Use existing frozen v1.3 candidate windows whose center lies inside a selected half-open audit interval [start,end). A center on the right boundary is excluded unless it belongs to a separately selected next interval. Both visual instruments receive the same ordered window set and the same fixed five-frame offsets. The restricted set digest never leaves quarantine.
